name: Power Cup TLR

origin.basis: French tire maker; Michelin's UK site lists its bicycle range and dealers.

manufacturing.basis: Michelin's size list does not state where these tires are made.

positioning: Michelin's tubeless road racing tire with GUM-X compound.
hookless_note: Michelin lists 28, 30 and 32 mm for hooked and hookless rims; the 25 mm size is listed for hooked rims only.
weight_basis: Maker claims as listed by Bicycle Rolling Resistance for 25 and 28 mm; Michelin's size list shows no weights.
pressure_note: Michelin's size list gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Sold by Michelin's official Tmall store in mainland China; listed on Michelin's UK site with a dealer locator; North American availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.market: Michelin official Tmall store (米其林官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 549.08.

caveats: The 25 mm size is not listed for hookless rims.
A 25 mm sample measured 28 mm wide in the lab; check frame clearance with your rim width.

image.shown: 700x25C Power Cup TLR as pictured on Michelin's product page.
image.alt: Michelin Power Cup TLR road tire standing upright at an angle

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: The perfect road tire: 2,200 km tubeless without a defect or air loss, very low rolling resistance and the rear tread still round.
A great tire that rolls superbly at an attractive price.
Supple with lots of cornering confidence, but after one mounting the stretched casing could not be refitted to any wheel.
Rolls superbly with the best grip after 500 km.
On 21 mm rims the owner was cornering on the sidewall and shows the resulting wear.
About 14 months on glass-strewn city roads without a cut or any issue; one of the fastest tires the owner has had.
Switched from a CADEX tire and finds the grip weaker than Pirelli or Continental.
